artworks.title: To the Village
artworks.medium: collage of pen and black ink, graphite and blue and red crayon on two overlapped sheets of paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with one leg slightly bent against a surface. He has a beard and mustache, and his head is slightly tilted to the right with his eyes looking forward. The man is wearing a suit, including a light-colored jacket, dark trousers, and a light shirt with a cravat. He is also wearing a tall top hat and a cummerbund around his waist. A dog is sitting beside him with its ears perked. In the background, there is a street scene depicted in black and white, showing a pathway lined with trees and buildings, with silhouetted figures in the distance.

artworks.title: Chez Maxime
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray wash over blue and black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a café terrace with a group of men in formal attire sitting and standing around small round tables. Most men wear top hats and jackets. One man has a prominent mustache and is dressed in checkered pants, smoking a cigarette. Another man is holding what looks like a newspaper or menu with a cigarette in his mouth. A woman walks past the tables in a dark cloak and hat, carrying a large package. Another woman stands closer, wearing a feathered hat. The background features a building with ornate details, large windows, street lighting, and city facades. The tables are adorned with drinks, a bottle, and ice buckets.

artworks.title: La chienne au loup
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with black and colored chalk
artworks.description: The image shows two people from the knee up. The man sits with his back against a tree trunk, his right arm draped over his knee. The woman leans over him, appearing to embrace him closely. The man has curly dark hair, a mustache, and a beard, wearing a jacket with buttons and an undershirt with a red accent. The woman has her hair styled up and wears a loose-sleeved blouse tucked into a long, flowing skirt. Lush greenery surrounds them, with detailed leaves and flowers. In the background, a night sky and a full moon illuminate a silhouette of a distant village with rooftops and a church spire.

artworks.title: Penitence
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with black and colored crayon
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a man, standing close to each other. The woman is facing the man with her hands clasped in front of her, slightly turned towards the right. She has a light complexion and wears a white headscarf, a long striped dress with a blue apron, and a patterned shawl. The man, facing the woman, wears a black hat, a long black robe, and holds a book. The background includes a stone wall, a wooden door, some trees, and a small group of buildings on a hillside.

artworks.title: Les petits joyeux
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and black ink, colored crayon and paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in a street scene with musical notation. The image features a group of individuals walking arm in arm down a street, with buildings and other people visible in the background. The people are depicted in a lively manner. The right half of the image shows a bustling street scene. On the left, there is a printed piece of sheet music with the title "Les Petits Joyeux." The sheet music complements the scene by adding a musical element. The handwritten annotations and colored illustration combine to create a multifaceted composition.

artworks.title: La Rafle
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and colored crayon
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a group scene with various figures lined up near a small building or vehicle. The composition includes people dressed in period clothing standing in line. One person in a black and red uniform stands aside with a neutral expression. The style hints at a historical setting, with clean lines and soft colors showing everyday life. The background shows urban architecture and additional figures in a queue, suggesting a busy environment typical of a past era.

artworks.title: Gillis de Glarges
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man with a full beard and mustache, wearing a 17th-century outfit including a ruff and fur-lined cloak. He is seated facing slightly to the left with a plain, dark background.

artworks.title: Andreas Rivetus
artworks.description: The image is a three-quarters view of a man's upper body in an oval frame. The man is facing slightly to his left but gazes directly at the viewer. He has a prominent nose, full lips, and a well-defined chin with a closely trimmed goatee. His eyebrows are arched and his expression is serious. His hair is curly and reaches just above his ears, and he wears a dark skullcap on his head. The man is dressed in traditional attire with a dark robe featuring an ornate button panel and wide, white collar. There are no visible objects or jewelry. The background of the oval frame contains text in Latin. Around the oval, there is a heavy border with decorative text. Below the image, there is additional neatly inscribed text. The overall aesthetic suggests a formal, historical portrait engraving.

artworks.title: Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man with a beard and mustache, positioned in a three-quarter view. He wears a cap and a dark garment with a shoulder chain. The portrait is framed with cherubs, garlands, and decorative motifs. Inscriptions and ornamental elements are present below the portrait.

artworks.title: David Nuyts
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man, depicting him from the chest upwards. He is positioned facing slightly towards the right with his gaze directed towards the viewer. The man has notable facial features with a long, narrow face, an aquiline nose, and a neatly styled mustache and short goatee. His hair is closely cropped around his head and is graying. He is wearing a large, elaborate ruff collar and a dark, buttoned garment with a subtle vertical pattern on the chest. The background consists of a solid dark texture, typical of engraved portraits. The engraving also includes decorative script and text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Johannes Been
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Hendrik Cornelisz van Vliet
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man seated in an ornate high-backed wooden chair. He has a long white beard and mustache, with visible wrinkles. His hair, concealed under a cap, reaches below his ears. He wears a dark robe with a white collar, adorned with tassels or braid patterns on the arms. On a nearby table, there are books, spectacles, and a crucifix. The wall behind him features a shield emblem with a floral design and a banner that reads "Vita Nihil." The setting suggests a scholarly atmosphere with religious iconography.

artworks.title: Theodorus Wikenburg
artworks.description: This print shows the upper half of a man's body, seated in a three-quarter position with his chest turned to the left and his face looking towards us with a neutral expression. He has pale skin, high cheekbones, short hair, and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. The man is dressed in a dark robe with a high white collar and buttons, and he is wearing a small cap on his head. His right hand is resting on his chest in the folds of his garment. The background is plain and gray, and the man casts a shadow on the left. Below the portrait, there is a decorative band with an inscription.

artworks.title: Franciscus Plante
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Dircksz Santvoort
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a seated or slightly turned position, facing forward. The man has a mustache and a small goatee, with wavy, shoulder-length hair parted in the middle. He wears a dark coat with a wide, white collar featuring a detailed lace pattern and a large button under the collar. The man's facial expression is calm, and his gaze is directed towards the viewer. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain and textured, with an elaborate inscription at the bottom containing a series of text lines in a decorative script. The text includes the name "Franciscus Plante" prominently displayed, along with additional information in smaller text.

artworks.title: Conrad Vietor van Aken
artworks.description: The image shows a man with an aged face, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, dark outfit with a white collar, and holding a closed book. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, against a plain textured background.

artworks.title: Adriaen Tegularius
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an older man seated from the waist up, with a slightly turned position to his right. He has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, deep eyes, and a full beard with a mustache. He has short, wavy hair and is wearing a dark garment with a textured pattern and a white ruffled collar peeking through. The man is holding an object in his right hand. The background has a closely knit pattern, and there is text below the portrait in a formal script.

artworks.title: Frederick Spanheim
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is shown slightly turned to his left with a solemn expression. The man has prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and a well-groomed beard. His hair is dark and chin-length, partially covered by a cap. He is wearing a dark robe with a wide white collar tied with a ribbon at the neck, and a draped mantle over his shoulders. The background has a textured pattern and there is Latin text above and below the portrait.

artworks.title: Jacob Revius
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man's upper body and head. He is seated and facing slightly towards the right side of the image. His facial features include a furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, a long, drooping mustache, and a short, pointed beard. He is wearing a dark, formal garment with a high, white collar and a richly textured fabric, along with a black cap. A jewel or badge is visible on his chest. The background is plain with a textured pattern, lacking any specific scenery or objects.

artworks.title: Johannes Hoornbeeck
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the waist up. He is facing the viewer with his body slightly turned to the right, and he holds an open book in his left hand. The man has defined facial features including a pronounced mustache and a neatly trimmed goatee. His dark hair is wavy and parted to the side, covering his ears and extending slightly down the nape of his neck. He is wearing a dark, buttoned coat and a white collar that is prominently displayed over the coat. The background is a simple, textured surface without any distinct elements. The text at the bottom identifies him as Johannes Hoornbeeck.

artworks.title: Nicolas Bodding van Laer
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man from the waist up, seated and facing slightly right. He has a full, long beard, a mustache, and closely cropped hair. He wears a dark textured garment with a pleated collar. He holds a quill pen above an open book. The background has a detailed texture. No jewelry or additional objects are visible.

artworks.title: Samuel Ampzing
artworks.description: The image shows a man with sharp features, wearing a dark cloak and a high, white ruffled collar. He holds a closed book in his right hand, seated at a slight angle. The background is a plain, textured surface with inscriptions at the top and bottom including his name and ornate script.

artworks.title: Julius Beyma
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man seated in a frontal position but slightly angled to one side. He has a long, sharply trimmed beard and mustache, with deep-set eyes and a serious expression. He wears a dark, round hat, a large, elaborately folded ruff around his neck, a dark jacket with a fur collar, and a garment buttoned up the front. There are no visible jewelry. The background has a crosshatched pattern within a decorated oval frame with text.

artworks.title: Eleazer Swalmius
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated with a three-quarter view of his body visible. He is sitting with one arm resting on a chair arm and the other hand placed on his chest. The man's face features a full beard and mustache, and he has closely cropped hair with visible thinning on top. His expression is calm, and he is gazing directly at the viewer. The man is wearing a fur-lined garment, likely a coat, which drapes around him. The background is plain with linear shading, and a small part of a wall or a frame is visible, suggesting an indoor setting. There is script positioned at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Jacob van Wassenaer van Obdam
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Gerrit van Honthorst
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man half-length. The man is facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has distinct facial features that include a prominent mustache and goatee. His hair is long, wavy, and parted in the middle. He is dressed in a period-appropriate outfit, featuring an armor breastplate with detailed rivets at the shoulder and a patterned cloak draped over his shoulders. A lace collar is visible beneath the cloak. In the top left corner, there is a coat of arms with a crown on top. The background is a dark, textured surface. There is scripted text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Constantijn L'Empereur
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a seated pose facing forward. He has a full beard, curled mustache, short hair, and is dressed in a dark formal garment with a large white collar. The garment has vertical lines and decorative elements. The man is surrounded by an oval frame with text. The background is textured with no visible scenery or details. He is not wearing any jewelry or holding any objects.
